{{Quote|The membibi certainly died quickly enough.''"<br/>"''The feeding thorns hold within them a strong nerve poison. Membibi or person, it makes no difference to the chawix. Or to the poison.|Luminara Unduli and Bulgan|<ref name="Approaching Storm" />}}
A '''membibi''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] four-[[Limb/Legends|legged]] [[Diet/Legends|insectivore]]<ref name="Approaching Storm" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the rocky outcroppings<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. Membibis had a low-slung snout protruding from the face with a splotchy pale [[Color/Legends|white]] body, which ended in a long whip&ndash;like tail.<ref name="Approaching Storm" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Approaching Storm Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|dispatched]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], along with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to Ansion. While there, the group witnessed a carnivorous [[chawix]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] [[Death/Legends|kill]] a membibi as the animal was running from its den to a nearby burrow. When Unduli expressed surprise at how quickly the membibi seemed to have died, [[Bulgan]], a [[Ansionian]] traveling with the group, explained that the membibi succumb to the [[Nervous system|nerve]] [[Poison/Legends|poison]] in the chawix's feeding thorns.<ref name="Approaching Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Membibi appeared in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'' written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="Approaching Storm" />
